Buys This Result: Paint that still looks wet two years from now, and a booked bay on Saturday.
Never Sell This: The polisher brand, the number of steps, the chemistry.
Proof Asset: Before and after of the same car from the same angle, six pairs minimum.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,500, then $200 to $400 a month for photos, reviews and offer swaps.
Local Signals: Mobile radius, insurance, brands of coating carried, warranty length.
Watch Out: Owners want to list every package tier. Cap it at three or the page stops converting.

Buys This Result: A car that survives winter salt and resells higher.
Never Sell This: Micron thickness, brand certifications, the installer's training.
Proof Asset: A close crop of a coated panel next to an uncoated one, same light.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $3,000, then $250 to $500 a month.
Local Signals: Warranty registration, certified installer badge, indoor bay.
Watch Out: Warranty language has to be exact. Copy the manufacturer wording, do not paraphrase it.

Buys This Result: A working drain today, at a price agreed before the truck leaves.
Never Sell This: The camera equipment, the truck stock list.
Proof Asset: Photos of finished repairs and a live review count.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,500, then $150 to $350 a month.
Local Signals: License number, 24-hour line, service radius in kilometres or miles, insured.
Watch Out: The phone number must be tappable and pinned on mobile. Most plumbing sites bury it.

Buys This Result: A panel that passes inspection and a house that stops tripping.
Proof Asset: Permit-passed job photos with the panel labelled.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,500, then $150 to $350 a month.
Local Signals: License number, permit history, insured, ESA or local authority mark.
Watch Out: Show the licence number in the footer on every page. Buyers check it.

Buys This Result: A house that holds temperature through the worst week of the year.
Never Sell This: SEER ratings and model numbers above the fold.
Proof Asset: A seasonal tune-up plan with prices, plus install photos.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $3,000, then $250 to $500 a month with seasonal offer swaps.
Local Signals: Brands serviced, emergency hours, financing available, insured.
Watch Out: Two seasons, two offers. Build the page so the hero offer swaps in one file.

Buys This Result: A roof that stops the leak and holds for twenty years.
Never Sell This: Shingle brand names in the hero.
Proof Asset: Drone or ladder shots of the same roof before and after, plus the warranty.
Money Shape: Build $2,000 to $4,000, then $300 to $600 a month.
Local Signals: Insurance, workers compensation coverage, years in business, warranty length.
Watch Out: Storm season doubles traffic. The quote form has to work on a phone in a driveway.

Buys This Result: A driveway that does not crack in the third winter.
Proof Asset: Same-driveway before and after, plus a cure timeline.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $3,000, then $200 to $400 a month.
Local Signals: Insured, years, service radius, finish types offered.
Watch Out: Photos are usually terrible. Reshoot two jobs before you build the page.

Buys This Result: A finished yard that the neighbours ask about.
Proof Asset: A gallery grouped by style, with a price per linear foot band.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,500, then $150 to $350 a month.
Local Signals: Insured, permit handling, material warranty, area.
Watch Out: Give a price per foot band. Hidden pricing kills the quote rate in this trade.

Buys This Result: A yard that stays done without the owner thinking about it.
Proof Asset: The same yard before and after from the same spot, across two seasons.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $3,000, then $250 to $450 a month.
Local Signals: Seasonal plans, insured, area by neighbourhood, crew size.
Watch Out: Sell the season, not the visit. Recurring beats one-off on this page.

Buys This Result: A green lawn on the schedule, billed the same amount every month.
Proof Asset: A route map and a plan table with monthly prices.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,000, then $150 to $300 a month.
Local Signals: Weekly or biweekly schedule, area, insured, pet-safe products.
Watch Out: One table with three plans and a signup button. Nothing else converts here.

Buys This Result: A dangerous tree gone, the yard clean, nothing damaged.
Proof Asset: Before and after with the clean-up visible, plus insurance proof.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,500, then $150 to $350 a month.
Local Signals: Liability coverage amount, arborist certification, emergency storm line.
Watch Out: Buyers are afraid of damage. Put the coverage amount in the hero proof strip.

Buys This Result: The problem gone and a guarantee that it stays gone.
Proof Asset: A treatment plan with the return-visit guarantee written out.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,200, then $200 to $400 a month.
Local Signals: Licensed applicator, pet and child safe, same-week availability, guarantee terms.
Watch Out: The guarantee is the offer. Put it in the H1, not in the FAQ.

Buys This Result: A pool that is always swimmable, without the owner testing anything.
Proof Asset: A monthly plan table and a photo of a clean pool at the same house across months.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,500, then $200 to $400 a month.
Local Signals: Weekly schedule, area, insured, opening and closing dates.
Watch Out: Seasonal in most markets. Build a winter version of the hero before you hand it over.

Buys This Result: A house that is clean when they get home, by someone they trust alone in it.
Proof Asset: A checklist of what is included, plus background-check language.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,200, then $150 to $350 a month.
Local Signals: Background checked, bonded and insured, recurring discount, area.
Watch Out: Give an instant price by bedroom count. Quote forms lose to price calculators here.

Buys This Result: An empty garage today.
Never Sell This: Truck sizes in cubic yards without a picture.
Proof Asset: A load-size price chart with photos of each size.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,000, then $150 to $300 a month.
Local Signals: Same-day, disposal and recycling policy, insured, area.
Watch Out: Price by picture. A truck diagram with prices beats any paragraph.

Buys This Result: Everything arrives unbroken and on the day promised.
Proof Asset: Reviews with move dates and a damage policy in plain words.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $3,000, then $250 to $450 a month.
Local Signals: Licensed and insured, hourly or flat rate, area, storage available.
Watch Out: Peak season is three months long. The quote form has to capture the date first.

Buys This Result: A door that opens tonight.
Proof Asset: Same-day photos plus a flat price list for the five common repairs.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,200, then $150 to $300 a month.
Local Signals: Same-day, license, insured, brands serviced, area.
Watch Out: Emergency traffic is mobile and impatient. Anything past a 2 second load loses the call.

Buys This Result: A fridge that runs again without buying a new one.
Proof Asset: Brands serviced grid and a flat diagnostic fee stated in the hero.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,000, then $150 to $300 a month.
Local Signals: Brands serviced, diagnostic fee, same-week booking, area.
Watch Out: List the brands as a grid. That grid is the whole search intent.

Buys This Result: Back inside the house in twenty minutes.
Proof Asset: Response time promise plus licence and reviews.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,000, then $150 to $300 a month.
Local Signals: 24-hour, licensed, bonded, response time, area.
Watch Out: Nothing but the phone number matters above the fold. Cut everything else.

Buys This Result: A visit that does not hurt and a bill they saw coming.
Proof Asset: New-patient offer, insurance list, and a real photo of the treatment room.
Money Shape: Build $2,500 to $5,000, then $400 to $800 a month.
Local Signals: Insurance accepted, new patient offer, emergency slots, parking, languages spoken.
Watch Out: Fear and cost are the two objections. Answer both above the fold.

Buys This Result: The result on their own face, from someone qualified.
Never Sell This: Device brand names in the hero.
Proof Asset: Real before and after with consent, same lighting, no filters.
Money Shape: Build $2,500 to $5,000, then $400 to $800 a month.
Local Signals: Practitioner credentials, consultation offer, financing, area.
Watch Out: Before and after images carry legal rules in many places. Check the local rule before you publish.

Buys This Result: Back to training or back to work by a date.
Proof Asset: A first-visit walkthrough and reviews naming the injury.
Money Shape: Build $2,000 to $4,000, then $300 to $600 a month.
Local Signals: Direct billing, credentials, same-week booking, parking.
Watch Out: Direct billing is the top question. Put the insurer list on the page, not in a PDF.

Buys This Result: A pet that gets better and an owner who is not panicking.
Proof Asset: Photos of the actual team with actual animals, plus emergency hours.
Money Shape: Build $2,000 to $4,000, then $300 to $600 a month.
Local Signals: Emergency hours, new client offer, species treated, parking.
Watch Out: Emergency hours belong in the header. Owners search at midnight.

Buys This Result: The look they saw and want to walk out with.
Proof Asset: Twelve close crops of real client hair, shot in the salon.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,500, then $200 to $400 a month.
Local Signals: Price ranges by service and stylist level, booking link, cancellation policy.
Watch Out: Print the prices. Salons that hide pricing lose the booking to the one that shows it.

Buys This Result: A cut that holds for three weeks and a chair that is free now.
Proof Asset: A gallery of finished cuts and a live booking link.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,000, then $150 to $300 a month.
Local Signals: Walk-in policy, price list, hours, barber names.
Watch Out: Booking software is the site. Build around the embed rather than beside it.

Buys This Result: A face that looks done without makeup.
Proof Asset: Close crops of real sets, before and after, same lighting.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,200, then $150 to $350 a month.
Local Signals: Price list, fill schedule, aftercare, certification.
Watch Out: Fill pricing is the retention lever. Give fills their own row in the price table.

Buys This Result: Hands that look right for the event on Saturday.
Proof Asset: A grid of real sets, sorted by shape and length.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,000, then $150 to $300 a month.
Local Signals: Walk-in hours, price list, sanitation policy, booking link.
Watch Out: Sanitation is a real objection now. Put the policy on the page in plain words.

Buys This Result: An hour that fixes the thing that hurts, covered by insurance.
Proof Asset: A room photo, credentials, and a direct-billing list.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,500, then $200 to $400 a month.
Local Signals: Registered therapist number, direct billing, parking, evening hours.
Watch Out: Say what each modality treats in one sentence. Names alone mean nothing to the buyer.

Buys This Result: A room they belong in and a body that changes in twelve weeks.
Proof Asset: Member results with names, faces and dates, plus a class schedule.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $3,000, then $250 to $500 a month.
Local Signals: Free trial week, class times, coach names, parking, drop-in rate.
Watch Out: The free trial button is the only money action. Do not compete with it.

Buys This Result: A specific body change by a specific date, with someone watching.
Proof Asset: Three client transformations with timelines, plus a consult booking.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,500, then $200 to $400 a month.
Local Signals: Certification, in-person or online, session pricing, first session offer.
Watch Out: Sell the consult, not the package. Packages get bought on the call.

Buys This Result: A table on Friday and a menu they could read on the walk over.
Proof Asset: Eight overhead food shots on the real tables, plus one room shot with people.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,500, then $200 to $400 a month for menu and photo updates.
Local Signals: Hours, address with map, phone, reservation link, delivery links.
Watch Out: Never a PDF menu. Real text, readable at 375px, or the page fails.

Buys This Result: A reason to walk in this morning and something to preorder for Sunday.
Never Sell This: Bean origin stories above the fold.
Proof Asset: Product shots that match what is in the case today, plus hours.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,000, then $150 to $350 a month.
Local Signals: Hours, address, order-ahead link, catering enquiry.
Watch Out: Hours change. Build the hours in one file so the swap takes a minute.

Buys This Result: A fed event that nobody complains about.
Proof Asset: Event photos with the spread laid out, plus package pricing per head.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,500, then $150 to $350 a month.
Local Signals: Minimum head count, service area, dietary options, booking calendar.
Watch Out: Price per head with a minimum. That one number decides the enquiry.

Buys This Result: Money kept, filings on time, and nobody calling from the tax office.
Never Sell This: Software brand logos as the main proof.
Proof Asset: Case results with real dollar figures and a fixed monthly fee table.
Money Shape: Build $2,000 to $4,000, then $300 to $600 a month.
Local Signals: Designation, years, industries served, software supported, deadline calendar.
Watch Out: Fixed monthly pricing wins over hourly. If they have it, put it on the page.

Buys This Result: The matter closed, with a person who answers the phone.
Proof Asset: Practice areas with outcomes, plus a real portrait and bar admission.
Money Shape: Build $2,500 to $5,000, then $400 to $800 a month.
Local Signals: Bar admission, years, free consult policy, languages, area.
Watch Out: Advertising rules vary by jurisdiction. Read the local bar rule before writing outcome claims.

Buys This Result: A house sold above list in fewer days than the area average.
Proof Asset: Recent sales with list price, sale price and days on market.
Money Shape: Build $2,000 to $4,000, then $300 to $600 a month with listing updates.
Local Signals: Brokerage, licence, area farmed, sold count, valuation offer.
Watch Out: The portrait is the hero. Book a real photographer before you build the page.

Buys This Result: An approval that closes on time at a rate they can check.
Proof Asset: Real closing stories with timelines, plus a rate table updated weekly.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $3,000, then $250 to $500 a month.
Local Signals: Licence number, lenders accessed, turnaround time, area.
Watch Out: Rate tables go stale fast. Build it as one file the client can update, or leave rates off.

Buys This Result: Rent that lands every month without the owner getting a single call.
Proof Asset: A fee table, a vacancy figure, and owner testimonials with unit counts.
Money Shape: Build $2,000 to $4,000, then $300 to $600 a month.
Local Signals: Units managed, fee percentage, vacancy rate, area, licence.
Watch Out: Two audiences share the page: owners and tenants. Split the nav at the top or lose both.

Buys This Result: Photos they will still be proud of in ten years.
Proof Asset: Twelve to twenty finished images at full bleed, one style per gallery.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,500, then $150 to $350 a month.
Local Signals: Packages with prices, travel area, turnaround time, booking calendar.
Watch Out: Fewest words wins. If the copy is longer than the gallery, cut the copy.

Buys This Result: A video that got used and got results.
Proof Asset: Three embedded finished pieces, each under 90 seconds, with the result named.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $3,000, then $200 to $400 a month.
Local Signals: Packages, turnaround, area, past clients.
Watch Out: Video embeds destroy load time. Poster image first, load the player on click.

Buys This Result: One day that goes right, run by someone who has done it fifty times.
Proof Asset: Full galleries from three real weddings, plus dated availability.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $3,000, then $200 to $400 a month.
Local Signals: Dates available, packages with starting prices, area, deposit terms.
Watch Out: Starting price stops the wrong enquiries. Put it on the page.

Buys This Result: A room they want to sit in, delivered on a budget they agreed.
Never Sell This: Software renders as the main proof.
Proof Asset: Before and after of the same room, same angle, real photography.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $3,000, then $200 to $400 a month.
Local Signals: Project minimum, area, service tiers, timeline.
Watch Out: Renders read as fake now. Lead with photographed finished rooms.

Buys This Result: One email a week they open, on a subject they already care about.
Never Sell This: The publishing schedule and the software stack.
Proof Asset: Three recent issues, the subscriber count, and the open rate if it is good.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,500, then $150 to $400 a month for issues and offer swaps.
Local Signals: Subscriber count, where the archive lives, who writes it, how often it lands.
Watch Out: A subscribe field below the fold collects nothing. It goes in the hero and again at the end.

Buys This Result: The next video worth thirty minutes, from someone who has done the thing.
Proof Asset: Real thumbnails and view counts from the last five videos.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,500, then $150 to $400 a month for page and thumbnail work.
Local Signals: Subscriber count, upload rhythm, the one topic the channel owns.
Watch Out: Embed the latest video, never a channel trailer nobody finished. The thumbnails are the design.

Buys This Result: An episode they finish on the drive, with a guest they wanted to hear.
Proof Asset: Three named guests, working listen links, and a chart position if there is one.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,500, then $150 to $400 a month for episode pages.
Local Signals: Guest names, episode count, where to listen, release day.
Watch Out: Put every listen platform in the hero. A page with one Spotify link loses half the audience.

Buys This Result: An argument they have not read anywhere else, written to be finished.
Proof Asset: The five best pieces, by headline, with dates.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,500, then $150 to $400 a month for new pieces.
Local Signals: Archive depth, who writes it, what it covers in one line.
Watch Out: The headline of the best piece is the hero. Do not bury writing behind a card grid.

Buys This Result: A read on the market they will act on, before the crowd has it.
Proof Asset: Two past calls with the date made and what happened after.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $3,000, then $200 to $500 a month for issues.
Local Signals: Who writes it, track record with dates, what it covers, publication schedule.
Watch Out: A dated call that turned out right beats every credential. Show the date.

Buys This Result: A record of what actually shipped, with the numbers attached.
Never Sell This: Roadmaps and what is coming next quarter.
Proof Asset: Dated log entries carrying real revenue or usage numbers.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,000, then $150 to $300 a month for log upkeep.
Local Signals: What is being built, current numbers, how often it updates.
Watch Out: Undated entries kill it. Every entry carries a date or it is not a log.

Buys This Result: A tool made by someone who uses it, still shipping this month.
Proof Asset: Screenshots of the real product and a changelog with dates.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $3,000, then $200 to $400 a month for release pages.
Local Signals: Last shipped date, who built it, what it costs, where the changelog is.
Watch Out: A product page with no price reads as abandoned. Put the number on it.

Buys This Result: A skill they can use this month, taught by someone who has been paid for it.
Never Sell This: Hours of content and module counts.
Proof Asset: Named student results with dates and numbers.
Money Shape: Build $2,000 to $4,000, then $250 to $500 a month for launches.
Local Signals: Who teaches it, what it costs, what happens after they join, refund terms.
Watch Out: Selling the curriculum is the trap. Sell the first result and the date they get it.

Buys This Result: A quote back today, from a page that asked four questions instead of twelve.
Never Sell This: Company history and the team page.
Proof Asset: Three results with real numbers that match what the ad promised.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,500, then $150 to $400 a month for offer swaps and testing.
Local Signals: Response time, service area, licence and insurance, review count.
Watch Out: Every extra form field costs leads. Four fields, then the call does the rest.

Buys This Result: The same fix the ad promised, from someone who answers the phone.
Never Sell This: Multi service menus and an about page.
Proof Asset: Job photos and a live review count from the ad's service area.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $2,500, then $150 to $400 a month for offer swaps and testing.
Local Signals: Phone number, service radius, hours, licence, insured.
Watch Out: No nav bar. Every link off this page is a lead you paid for and lost.

Buys This Result: One hour that teaches the thing, on a date they can put in the calendar.
Proof Asset: Past attendance numbers and two named attendee results.
Money Shape: Build $1,500 to $3,000, then $200 to $400 a month for each new date.
Local Signals: The date, the time with a timezone, who runs it, what it costs.
Watch Out: No date and no timezone converts badly. Put both above the fold.

Buys This Result: A call worth taking, with the price band known before they book it.
Proof Asset: Three named client results with numbers and dates.
Money Shape: Build $2,500 to $5,000, then $300 to $600 a month for offer swaps and testing.
Local Signals: Who is behind it, the price band, who it is not for, what happens on the call.
Watch Out: Hiding the price band fills the calendar with the wrong calls. State it and filter early.
